seo.description: Tegel Design System home page concept.

hero.title: Tegel Design System
hero.lead: A faster, CMS-managed Astro site for Scania's modular system for digital products and services.

intro.title: Built for premium digital experiences.
intro.body: Tegel becomes less of a component catalogue and more of a guided system: start from the Scania experience, choose the right component, then ship the implementation with the same precision.

principles.title: Precision down to the grid
principles.description: Foundation guidance is moved up front, with tokens, typography, and spacing treated as the start of every decision.

principles.title: Components with context
principles.description: Each route starts from the job a team is trying to do, then points to the right Tegel component and implementation pattern.

principles.title: Delivery without drift
principles.description: Design, code, and quality standards are kept together so teams can move from Figma to implementation with less handoff loss.

contact.title: Choose the right communication channel.
contact.body: Use the channel that matches the work: quick team alignment, scoped follow-up, or implementation issues that need tracking.

links.title: Teams channel
links.label: Open Teams
links.description: Use Teams for quick alignment, design reviews, and questions that need a shared thread.

links.title: Email the Tegel team
links.label: Write email
links.description: Use email for scoped requests, onboarding support, and decisions that need a clear owner.

links.title: GitHub issues
links.label: Open issues
links.description: Report component defects, documentation gaps, and implementation problems.
